authorReviewNote: Try5points, not3/2/1. Actual World Rugby2026 scoring list read, normal try distinct penaltytry7. No historic4point scoring or league4point confusion; rugby union explicit. Short clear meaning and options.

Conversion2points, not1/3/5. Same current2026 scoring list separately explicit, distinct try/penalty values. Successful qualifier avoids missed kick/penaltytry automatic points confusion. Numeric options parallel.

Hand pass backward/sideways relative passer; intentional forward prohibited. Actual2026 law11 and throw-forward arms definition inspected. Added relative-passer wording to avoid ground-momentum misconception when a runner passes legally. Other choices forwards-only/unrestricted/vertical-only wrong limits.

Standard law3.1 maximum15players. Actual2026 NUMBERS text checked separately from sevens variation which quotes and replaces it. Removed fifteen-a-side giveaway, maximum instead of everyone must startfullteam. Eleven/thirteen/seven other formats/sports, none standardlimit.

Lineout restart after touch, not awardungroundedtry/penaltyshootout/tiebreak. World Rugby RugbyReady actual lineout introduction and law definition explicit. Does not say every touch must be lineout because quick throw may apply. Plain definition, not lifting safety instruction.
Six indoor volleyball players per team in play, not4/5/7. Actual FIVB2025-28rule7.3.1 inspected. Standard indoor qualifier excludes beach/sitting-format confusion, not total roster. No stem giveaway.

Spike forceful attacking hit, other choices set/service/forearm receive different actions. Restored mismatched numerical answers accidentally applied to this unapproved draft during earlier row-number edit; now all four options checked against this exact prompt. FIVB rule13 attack direction plus official drillbook explicit indoor power comparison inspected. Main aim permits block-out/tactical variations.

Serve starts rally, notfaceoff/scrum/centrebounce from other sports. FIVB actual12service definition puttingballintoplay checked. Scope indoor; no unsupported requirement all serves underhand or hit without net contact.

Block intercepts attack atnet. Restored original volleyball prompt after an earlier unapproved row-number edit accidentally put rugby-player-count stem above block options. All four exact options now reviewed. Current FIVB14.1.1 explicit opponent-ball interception; wrong service/endchange/scoringofficial actions not blockpurpose.

Three teamhits besides blockcontact, not2/4/5. Actual FIVB9.1 and14.4.1 inspected; blocknotcountedasonehit. Normally covers simultaneous-contact/exceptional situations without claiming a player may always hit twice consecutively. Not beach blockcount rule.

Six batting hit first grounded beyondboundary with no groundinside. Actual current MCC2026law19.7.1 read; fielder contact doesn't alter that by itself. Other wicketcount/no-ballautomatic6/stumps options wrong. Replaced standard-over6 question duplicated in old bank.

Running betweenwickets scores runs, notsets/goals/frames. Actual MCC2026law18.1.1 crossing/makingground explicit. Replaced duck definition duplicated in old bank. No claim all attempted runs count or batters need physically touch stumps.

Keeper behind striker wicket, notbowler'srunup/boundary/sightscreen. Actual MCC2026law27.3.1 read with after-delivery release conditions. Normally definition position, not claim keeper must remain there entire innings regardless ball state. Batter's wicket unambiguous strikerend here.

Batting pads protect lowerlegs, cap/visor/wristband other regions. Actual MCC2026AppendixA.2 identifies external legguards as battingpads. No exclusive claim only batters have pads or all recreational equipment mandatory. Grammar genderneutral batter.

Ordinary boundary allowance4 after shot groundedinside, not2/6/8. Actual MCC2026law19.7.2/19.7.3 read. Reworded to usual boundaryallowance rather than totalrunsalways4 because completedruns can exceed allowance. No confusion sixfirstbounceoutside or boundary extras not bat.

Doublefault failing both serviceattempts for samepoint, notlets/doublebounces/sharedracket. USTA actual definition read. Changed consecutive faulty serves wording to avoid misleading let/retry sequence implication. Replaced love-zero fact overlapping old love-all question.

Deuce40all under advantage scoring, not30all/15all/unansweredgamepoint. USTA actual dictionary deuce40all definition checked; repeated deuce allowed. Ordinaryadvantage qualifier excludes no-ad decidingpoint formats without claiming all tennis games identical.

Volley rallyshot beforebounce, notnetfault/twobounce/6allscore. Actual USTA volley definition read; added duringrally so airborne serve not misclassified. Volley need not mean winning shot or forehand-only; no implied netcontact.

Serve diagonaloppositeservicebox, notarbitrarybox/ownbox/behindbaseline. USTA actual serving article says diagonalotherbox explicitly. Standardserve scope applies singles/doubles, does not confuse let that lands rightbox with fault. Current ITF PDF directstub not claimed as read.

Ace untouchedlegalserve winningpoint, notlongrally/doublefaultaward/netposthit. Actual USTA ace definition inspected. Added winningpoint and legal explicit, no claim every unreturnedserve ace. Not relying on exaggerated speed or firstserve-only premise.

Birdie1underpar, not1over/2over/par. Actual USGA2026 terminology article indexed passage explicit; directfetchfailed honestly recorded. Existing birdie etymology question asks different fact, not same definition. No unsupported historical origin asserted.

Bogey1overpar, not1under/2under/par. Same USGA article explicitly currentmeaning after historicaltargetscore discussion; checked correct temporal sense. Clear normalgolf context, no confusion doublebogey2over.

Putter primarily puttinggreen, otherclubs driving/sand/wood different intendedroles. R&A actual EquipmentRules general defines putter for puttinggreen; not just random use in a rule example. Mainly permits putting from fringe/otherclubs sometimes used ongreen. No arbitrary loft-number trivia.

Lowest totalstrokes wins regularstrokeplay, nothighest/ballsused/distancetravelled. R&A actual StrokePlay definition inspected, including penaltystrokes. Ordinary excludes Stableford/modifiedscoring/handicapformat nuance; better finalanswer explicitly includes penalties.

Fore warning, nottennislove/let/crickethowzat. Actual R&A SpiritSafety paragraph explicitly dangerousball warningword. No source etymology guess or claim shout guarantees protection. Correct exclamation spelling and plain sensiblequestion.
